      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests category excludes area-specific tests that pin the behavior of wallet features."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in `src/common/paymentdestination.*` and `src/common/bip352.*` implement destination abstractions and cryptography specific to BIP 352.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Utils excludes changes whose core point is another subsystem's behavior rather than shared node-wide utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies transaction creation, coin selection, fee bumping, database persistence, and wallet RPCs across `src/wallet/` to implement BIP 352 Silent Payment sending.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds user-facing BIP 352 Silent Payment sending support to the wallet, resolving a major privacy limitation where users could not send to silent payment addresses. Adapts core coin selection and derivation logic during transaction creation, with substantial durable value for wallet users."
